name: Megan Lockhart
source:
Megan is Riley's friend. She's in the same class as Riley. She likes drawing and she has started practicing drawing digital art recently. She was convinced to join Riley's computer club due to the lack of a digital art club.
Megan can be found in the art classroom.
translation:
Megan is Riley's friend. She's in the same class as Riley. She likes drawing and she has started practicing drawing digital art recently. She was convinced to join Riley's computer club due to the lack of a digital art club.
Megan can be found in the art classroom.
